acceptance.given: Three primary examples exist and their declared sequence is being validated.

oracle.expected: The validator confirms the primary examples occur in the declared order.
forbidden: The primary examples appear in the wrong order.
oracle.observable: Validator output records a passing primary-order check.

acceptance.then: The primary examples are in the required order.
acceptance.when: When the authoring validator evaluates primary example ordering.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run primary-order validation against an out-of-order primary-example fixture.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate and report the required order of the three primary examples.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change.

slice_hint.state_transition: Primary ordering moves from validation input to an explicit order diagnostic.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The order selector confirms required order and rejects an out-of-order fixture.
